description: This file defines a view class 'ImportViewDupcheck' for handling the duplicate check step in the import process of the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM system. It includes methods for rendering the view, preparing JavaScript for the import process, and managing duplicate check configurations.

classes.name: ImportViewDupcheck
classes.description: A class extending ImportView, responsible for handling the duplicate checking interface during import. It manages UI rendering, duplicate index configurations, and JavaScript interaction for the import process.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the duplicate check view, assigns template variables, and displays the wizard wrapper.

methods.name: getImportMap
methods.description: Retrieves the import mapping configuration from request or database based on source ID.

methods.name: _getJS
methods.description: Generates the JavaScript code required for the duplicate check step, including setup for file splitting, drag-and-drop duplicate selection, and form submission.
